criteria.text: Returns a markdown bullet list with one line per heading up to maxDepth, indented two spaces per level below the minimum heading level present

evidence: independent run of `npm test` passed (4 passed)

[model] Code indents using '  '.repeat(level - minLevel), filters entries by maxDepth, and formats as markdown bullet list; Test 2 verifies depth=3 limits 4 levels to 3 and produces correct 0/2/4-space indentation.

grader.evidence: toc walks lines, keeps ATX headings with level <= maxDepth, computes minLevel = min of matched levels and indents '  '.repeat(level - minLevel). Verified: '# Title/## Section/### Sub/#### Deep' with maxDepth 3 -> "- [Title](#title)\n  - [Section](#section)\n    - [Sub](#sub)" (#### dropped); '## Deep start/### Child' -> top entry unindented, child at 2 spaces; maxDepth 1 -> only '- [A](#a)'.

criteria.text: Each heading line links to a GitHub-style anchor (lowercase, spaces to hyphens, punctuation removed, duplicates suffixed -1, -2, etc.)

evidence: independent run of `npm test` passed (4 passed)

[model] slugify() applies .toLowerCase(), .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '') for punctuation removal, .replace(/\s+/g, '-') for spaces, and uses Map to suffix duplicates -1, -2; Test 3 verifies 'Hello, World!' → 'hello-world' and duplicate suffixed -1.

grader.evidence: slugify() lowercases, trims, strips /[^\w\s-]/g, converts whitespace runs to '-', and a Map-based counter appends -1/-2. Verified: '# Hello, World!' twice -> '#hello-world' and '#hello-world-1'; '# A!/# A?/# A' -> a, a-1, a-2. Two corner-case deviations from real GitHub: consecutive spaces left by removed punctuation are collapsed to one hyphen ('# C++ & Rust: A "Guide"?' -> '#c-rust-a-guide' where GitHub yields '#c--rust-a-guide'), and non-ASCII letters are stripped ('# Cafe & Noño' -> '#cafe-noo', GitHub keeps 'ñoño'). The enumerated rules in the criterion all hold; untested links break only
